topic: Management as Art, Science and Profession
title: Is Management an Art or a Science? | Principles of Management Ep 3
description:
Is management a gift, a set of rules, or a profession like medicine? In Episode 3 of our Principles of Management series, Ravi's team at Chai Corner cannot agree, so we put management through three simple tests.

You will learn why management is an art (personal skill, practice, creativity and results), why it is a science but an inexact, social one (a systematic body of knowledge built on cause and effect, applied to people), and why it is only partly a profession: it has specialised knowledge, formal education, a professional body like the All India Management Association (AIMA) and a code of conduct, but no compulsory licence like doctors and lawyers.

In this video:
0:00 Three friends, three answers
0:18 Art, science or profession?
0:24 Test 1: Is management an art?
0:51 Test 2: Is management a science?
1:22 Test 3: Is management a profession?
2:03 The verdict
2:18 Quick check
2:28 Recap
